def main():
    n = int(input())
    adict = dict(zip(list(range(1, n + 1)), list(map(int, input().split()))))
    iset = set(adict.keys())
    aset = set(adict.values())
    first = (aset - iset).pop()
    order = []
    while first != -1:
        order.append(first)
        first = adict[first]
    print(order)

main()
